text:
maya_k: quick scheduling check — candidate Saman is set for an onsite loop this Thurs. Proposed slot 10:30-11:00 PT. we need 3 panelists + 1 note-taker. who's available? @taylor_pm i think you mentioned v2 of the rubric — can you confirm which one to use?

taylor_pm: confirmed, use rubric eng-panel-v2 (latest). emphasize system design + production tradeoffs. link: https://redwood.app/rubrics/eng-panel-v2 :link:

jordan_r: I can do 10:30-11:00 PT, happy to take notes during the debrief.

alex_g: available, though I have a sync at 11:00 — i can join full slot if we keep to 10:30-11. will cover performance/infra questions.

rachel_recruiter: candidate prefers remote and will join via Zoom. i'll add interview packet and resume to the event. resume: https://redwood.app/candidates/saman/resume.pdf

maya_k: thanks. quick rubric clarifying Q: when scoring tradeoffs (e.g., batching, KV cache), do we use the 0-3 scale or the 0-5 one? want to be consistent across panelists.

taylor_pm: use the 0-3 scale in v2. scoring guidance: 3 = strong, 2 = acceptable with minor gaps, 1 = major gaps, 0 = missing/incorrect. add short comment for any 1/0.

jordan_r: for practical notes, i'll copy this format into the doc and fill during interview:
```
System design: 3 - clear tradeoffs, addressed caching + failure modes
Coding: 2 - small bug in boundary condition but explained fix
Behavioral: 3 - good product sense
Overall: Hire / No Hire
```

alex_g: also add one production probe: "describe how you'd reduce 99th pctl latency when KV cache hit-rate drops under load" — helps differentiate infra experience.

taylor_pm: +1 on that probe. i'll add 2 more prompts focused on telemetry and rollout strategy.

interview-bot: Meeting created: Thu, 10:30 AM PT — Zoom link added to calendar. Attendees: maya_k, jordan_r, alex_g, taylor_pm, rachel_recruiter. Calendar: https://calendar.redwood.app/event/1749123456 :calendar:

rachel_recruiter: pinging to confirm note-taker — jordan confirmed. i'll also send candidate tech stack and coding exercise summary to panelists 24h before.

maya_k: perfect. last quick question — do we want a short shared debrief doc (google doc) or just use the rubric fields in Greenhouse? i'd prefer a quick shared doc for immediate notes.

jordan_r: shared doc is faster for live debrief, then transfer final scores to Greenhouse. i'll create and link it in the event.

alex_g: fine by me. i'll prepare 2 short system prompts for the interview (latency, caching).

taylor_pm: thanks all — i'll finalize rubric link in the event and post the 3 probe questions in the doc by EOD.

maya_k: thanks team :thumbsup: i'll send final invite and confirm panel list once doc is up.

rachel_recruiter: noted — i'll message candidate logistics and include interview prep note.

maya_k: closing loop — see you Thursday.
